display.title: Tanya Shiur 48: Chapter 36, Matan Torah and the Days of Moshiach (Elul)
display.summary_short: Two Yiddish Tanya classes finishing chapter 36: the Baal Shem Tov and the child playing hide-and-seek, the revelation at Matan Torah as a foretaste of Moshiach, and an Elul talk before Rosh Chodesh.
display.summary_long: Shiur 48 in Rabbi Yosef Goldstein's Yiddish Tanya series holds two weekly classes on Tanya chapter 36, followed by a talk for the month of Elul. It opens with the Baal Shem Tov's love for Jewish children and his story of a boy who cried because his friends stopped looking for him: Hashem, too, hides so that we will search for Him. The class studies how at Matan Torah the whole world heard 'I am Hashem your G-d', a foretaste of what Moshiach will bring. The second class completes the chapter: the Ten Commandments revealed Hashem's inner will, explained through the soul's inner and surrounding powers; the three meanings of 'Toras Chaim', with the Baal Shem Tov's teaching about reading the Megillah out of order; the dew of Torah that revives the dead; the coarsening after the golden calf; and the light of Moshiach that will reach the nations. After a call to ask each day what one is doing to hasten Moshiach, the Elul talk explains the two halves of the year from Nissan and from Tishrei, 'Ani l'dodi', and the Thirteen Attributes of Mercy, and stops before the promised parable.
display.lesson: The whole purpose of creation is the days of Moshiach, and Torah study gives every Jew the strength to receive that light; in Elul one should take the first step toward Hashem.

date.note: Second class is in the week before Shabbos Re'eh, Rosh Chodesh Elul, which 'this year' falls on Shabbos (true of 5738, 5745, 5748); ASR year reads 573x-8.

study_text.note: Two weekly classes; the second finishes the chapter.

segments.title: First class: Tanya chapter 36, Matan Torah as a foretaste of Moshiach
segments.summary: At Matan Torah the whole world heard Hashem's words, a preparation for the revelation of Moshiach.

segments.title: The Baal Shem Tov and the child who hid too well
segments.summary: A boy cried because his friends stopped searching for him; so too Hashem hides so that we will look for Him.

segments.title: Second class: Hashem's will revealed in the Torah
segments.summary: The Ten Commandments, inner and surrounding powers of the soul, 'Toras Chaim', the dew of revival, the golden calf, and the light of Moshiach for Israel and the nations.

segments.title: A living Torah: reading the Megillah out of order
segments.summary: The Baal Shem Tov taught that one who reads the Torah as a story of the past does not fulfill his duty.

segments.title: The purpose of creation: bringing Moshiach
segments.summary: Every day one should ask what one is doing to hasten Moshiach, as the Frierdiker Rebbe wrote.

segments.title: Preparing for Elul: Ani l'dodi and the Thirteen Attributes
segments.summary: The two halves of the year, from above and from below, and Elul as the month of mercy; the recording stops before the parable.

relations.note: Both study Tanya ch. 36; 49 P36a covers the chapter's opening, so it likely precedes this shiur despite the numbering.
